decisions.reason: A multi-model executive desk system with its own page and established-offer building represents high visible investment and commitment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping very unlikely.
The chair family's own page and closeness to the established offer signal public commitment and sunk costs that favor persistence.
Floor cushions as a multi-model line with its own page reflect visible investment and public commitment, so escalation of commitment predicts keeping it.
The high standing table has a public page but less investment than multi-model lines; escalation of commitment still favors keeping it, though with a slightly higher drop probability.
As a distant flagship presented as the focus of the firm's direction, the rug collection has high centrality, visibility, and investment, so escalation of commitment strongly predicts persistence.
